description: The whole of what the Chat window is allowed to do: listen for the two events the Rust shell emits, and call the three commands that are the three ACP calls `heddle acp-agent` already serves. Deny-by-default is Tauri's own model here (Constitution VI) - the frontend has no shell, no filesystem, no HTTP and no process permission, so it cannot spawn an agent, read a directory or reach a provider even if its code tried to.
